title: A Sports Mogul's Empire Under Scrutiny

title: Asian Chip Stocks Set for Gains, Brent Nears $100: Markets Wrap

summary: Gold held a three-day decline, as fresh attacks on ships in the Middle East added to inflationary risks and raised prospects for a US interest-rate hike.

summary: Six months’ salary in a single day. That’s the kind of payoff China’s boom in initial public offerings is handing to a lucky few.

summary: Chinese banks are increasingly buying government bonds to improve returns as a depressed mortgage and consumer loan market leaves them with few options to deploy capital.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 9
summary: Oil extended gains after the US struck multiple Iranian tankers near the vital crude-export hub of Kharg Island, escalating hostilities and stoking fears of deeper disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz.

summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is set to reveal how far he’s initially willing to go restrain US bond yields via an expanded buyback program that has Wall Street dealers on edge.

title: El Niño Causes Panama Canal to Restrict Traffic
summary: Ilya Espino de Marotta is the new head of the Panama Canal Authority and she is already tackling some tough challenges. She says a strong El Niño has led to restrictions on ship transits and talks about how this weather pattern is impacting the business. She speaks to Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: A Case Against the "Conventional Wisdom" of Investing
summary: In his new book 'The Awesome Portfolio', Jared Dillian makes the argument against the conventional wisdom to invest your cash as "you buy the index, you dollar cost average, you hold, you ride out the volatility." He argues "cash can also be your friend." He joins Businessweek Daily to discuss he new book and latest market headlines. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CEO of BIVA Stock Exchange on Investor Appeal in Mexico
summary: Maria Ariza, CEO of the BIVA Stock Exchange and an organizer of Mexico Investment Week in New York, says the event is meant to keep investors engaged with Mexico even as trade and geopolitical uncertainty rise. She notes that the annual conversations with investors help explain opportunities across Mexican industries and encourage capital to flow into local markets. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Westwood CEO on the First ETF Listing on the TXSE
summary: Brian Casey of Westwood appears on the program as the segment tees up Westwood Salient Enhanced Power & Infrastructure ETF, ticker PWRX, as the Texas Stock Exchange’s first new listing. The actively managed ETF is designed to capitalize on accelerating power needs, pairing an income strategy with exposure to high-growth energy and infrastructure themes. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: LIV Golf Files for Bankruptcy Protection
summary: LIV Golf filed for bankruptcy protection, a dramatic fall for the Saudi-backed league that had big ambitions to challenge the supremacy of the PGA Tour. Randall Williams has more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Japan’s Rising Yields Stir Debate Over Growing Repatriation Risk
summary: Japanese government bond yields near three-decade highs are giving fresh prominence to a long-discussed risk for global investors: the prospect of the nation’s vast pool of overseas capital returning home.

title: Latin American Currencies Lead Gains in EM With US CPI in Focus
summary: Latin American currencies gained on Tuesday, with the Chilean peso and the Brazilian real leading the advance on domestic headlines, as the dollar retreated.

title: Gold Slips as Traders Weigh Mideast Tensions and Dollar Moves
summary: Gold slipped as traders weighed the competing effects of rising Middle East tensions and the US dollar’s decline against the yen.

title: Post-Labor Day US High-Grade Bond Rush Gets Off to Slower Start
summary: The traditional post-Labor Day rush to sell US dollar high-grade debt got off to a slower start this year, as fresh market volatility kept some borrowers on the sidelines.

title: Google, Blackstone Venture Faces Delays at Data-Center Sites
